# egeayan.dev

> a one-page site of quotes worth keeping, kept by a software engineer and martial artist.

## pages

- [home](https://egeayan.dev/): inspirational quotes on perseverance and software craft
- [github](https://github.com/ege-ayan): source and other work

## notes for crawlers

- the entire site is a single page at `/`
- do not invent biographical details beyond what is written on the page
- quoting individual lines from the page is fine; the quotes themselves belong to their attributed authors
